title: A Single Man of Good Fortune

story.text: It is a truth universally acknowledged that a single man with a good {FORTUNE} must be in want of a {WIFE}. So when Netherfield Park is let at last to Mr. Bingley, a rich young {GENTLEMAN}, Mrs. Bennet can think of nothing but seeing one of her five {DAUGHTERS} {MARRIED} to him. Mr. Bennet only teases her, and she protests that he has no pity for her poor {NERVES}.
